verdicts.reason: A: the FREE ENTRY and ALL AGES pills overlap, and ALL AGES is cut off at the right edge. The missing-asset box crashes into the 'Saturday 21 June' line, and the legal text sits large in the middle of the canvas under the subhead. On the plus side, the RSVP button stays prominent. B: the big two-line headline anchors the left, but the RSVP button has shrunk to the size of the three tag pills, so the call to action is buried. The 'SOLSTICE' logo text looks broken ('SOLST CE'), the date has an awkward gap above its details, and the elements are scattered across four loose columns. B wins slightly because it has fewer hard collisions and nothing clipped.
